mapper.select: SELECT s.id, j.bpm_unit, s.note_count, s.score_version FROM songs s JOIN jangdans j ON j.id = s.jangdan_id WHERE s.id = #{songId} AND s.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND s.is_scorable AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO practice_sessions (user_id, song_id, parent_session_id, score_version, bpm, bpm_unit, idempotency_key, request_hash, start_note_idx, end_note_idx, status, started_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{songId}, #{parentSessionId}, #{scoreVersion}, #{bpm}, #{bpmUnit}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{requestHash}, #{startNoteIdx}, #{endNoteIdx}, 'RECORDING', #{startedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT ps.id AS session_id, ps.user_id, ps.song_id, ps.bpm, ps.bpm_unit, ps.start_note_idx, ps.end_note_idx, ps.status, e.id AS evaluation_id, ps.fail_reason, (ps.recording_url IS NOT NULL AND ps.record_deleted_at IS NULL) AS recording_available, ps.started_at, ps.ended_at, ps.analysis_started_at, ps.saved_at, ps.memo FROM practice_sessions ps LEFT JOIN evaluations e ON e.session_id = ps.id WHERE ps.id = #{sessionId} AND ps.user_id = #{userId}
